parsed.rationale: One participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The other record is a production method in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel). Merging or extracting shared code from this cluster would couple the production DebugPanel package to demonstration-context semantics defined in the Wallpaper sample app. The duplication is intentional: the sample app re-implements updateMetrics locally to remain self-contained without depending on the DebugPanel production package.
